profile_text.body:
SoftBank Group (SoftBank Group Corp.) is a public company founded in 1981 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Its official site identifies Masayoshi Son as representative director, chairman and president executive officer. The site presents the company's philosophy, vision, strategy, corporate information, shareholder and investor relations information, business segments and group companies, and sustainability and ESG information.

The site also introduces the company's thinking in what it calls the era of the AI revolution, along with group company initiatives and the possibilities it says AI brings. The company trades under the ticker SFTBF and has SEC Central Index Key 0001065521.
